rules.name: Follow-Up Attack
rules.description: Once per round, if Michonne kills or makes an enemy Prone with a melee attack, she may immediately perform a second melee attack as a Free Action against another enemy in contact. If there is no enemy in contact, Michonne may instead move into base contact with another standing enemy in her Kill Zone (unless it is impossible to make contact for whatever reason), and immediately perform her Follow-Up Attack against the fresh enemy.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Gain 1Red to bonus when in cover.

rules.name: Proving His Worth
rules.description: While Scott is within the group Leader’s Kill Zone, he rolls 1Black at the start of each of his activations. On a Shield, the group Leader gains a +1 Action counter. On a blank, Scott gains a +1 Action counter.

rules.name: Someone to Fight For (Carl Grimes; Duane)
Grief-Stricken
rules.description: At the start of each of Morgan’s activations (before applying the effects of Fear), roll 1Blue. This is how many Actions Morgan may take this round. Furthermore, if Morgan begins an activation unengaged, and there are any enemy models in his Kill Zone, he must move into contact with at least one of those enemies as his first Action if possible.

rules.name: His Father's Son
rules.description: Duane may only be included in a group that also includes Morgan: Cynthiana Survivor.

rules.name: Atonement
rules.description: When Gabriel is removed from play, before removing the model give a +1 Action token to one friendly model within 6".

rules.name: Soft-Hearted
rules.description: Gabriel cannot score Headshots against Survivors (Critical rolls still count towards Ammo rolls if applicable).

rules.name: Holy Bible
rules.description: As a Special Action, cause NOISE. Then, this model and all friendly models in its Kill Zone are immune to Fear until the end of their next activation.

rules.name: I Ain't Goin' Back
rules.description: Reggie may reroll blanks when performing ranged attack rolls at Short range against enemy Survivors with a Lawful Alignment.

rules.name: Father Figure
rules.description: Clementine may only be included in a group that also includes Lee. If Lee is the group Leader, Clementine’s Strategy Rating becomes X/1Red.

rules.name: Adaptable*
rules.description: Clementine does not have a fixed Character Type, but instead must choose her Type each time she’s activated. Clementine never counts towards the character type restrictions when choosing a group.

rules.name: Got You Covered
rules.description: When Abraham wounds an enemy model, he may spend 1SP. If he does, one unengaged friendly model in his Kill Zone may immediately perform a Move Action, even if it has already activated this round. This is a Free Action, performed out of sequence. It does not use an Action from either model. Once the Move is complete, continue Abraham’s activation (if he has any actions remaining).

rules.name: Secure the Objective
rules.description: Abraham may spend 1SP when a member of his group controls a Static Objective in the Scoring part of the End Phase. That model gains 1 extra VP.

rules.name: Extremely Intelligent
rules.description: Once per game, in the Strategy phase, when the opponent takes the Initiative, Eugene may steal the Initiative. If the opponent also has the ability to steal Initiative, it may be stolen back again!

rules.name: Good Liar
rules.description: Enemy models within 6” of Eugene who wish to use a Strategy or Special Order must spend double the usual number of SP.

rules.name: Covert Maneuvers
rules.description: When an enemy performs a ranged attack against Rosita at Medium or Long range, she adds 1White to her defense roll if the attacker scores any blanks. If there is a friendly Abraham Ford or Eugene Porter model in Rosita’s Kill Zone, they also benefit from this rule.Friendly Abraham Ford or Eugene Porter models in Rosita's Kill Zone also benefit from this rule.

rules.name: Steadying Influence
rules.description: If Abraham is the group Leader and is in play, his Strategy Rating becomes 1Blue/1Red.

rules.name: Medical Assistant
rules.description: As an Action, Alice may restore 1White Health points lost earlier in the game to herself or a friendly model in her Kill Zone.

rules.name: Reluctant Follower
rules.description: Alice may never be the target of a Woodbury Commander’s Special Orders. However, she ignores the Conscript Militia special rule.

rules.name: Clinical Fire
rules.description: If Andrea kills or makes Prone an enemy with a ranged attack at Short range, she may immediately perform a second ranged attack as a Free Action (this Free Action does not generate further attacks).

rules.name: Didn't Hurt His Brain
rules.description: Billy & Ben cannot score Headshots (Critical rolls still count towards Ammo rolls if applicable).

rules.name: Split Up!
rules.description: Billy & Ben may spend two Actions instead of one when performing the Scavenge Action, to gain +1 Victory Point.

rules.name: Bottom of a Bottle
rules.description: Bottom of a Bottle: Unless a friendly Lilly model is within 6”, Bob treats all enemies as if they cause Fear.

rules.name: Unstable
rules.description: At the start of each of Carol’s activations (before applying the effects of Fear), roll 1White. This is how many Actions Carol may take this round. If there is a friendly Sophia model in play, roll 1Blue instead.

rules.name: Spotter
rules.description: Dale may spend an Action to give one friendly model in his Kill Zone that is yet to activate a bonus 1Red to their next ranged attack roll. If the bonus die is not used this round, it is lost.

rules.name: Medical Professional
rules.description: As an Action, Stevens may restore 1White Health points lost earlier in the game to himself or a friendly model in his Kill Zone.

rules.name: Dirty Fighter
rules.description: If Eugene performs a melee attack and fails to beat the target's defense roll, immediately roll 1Red and add it to the attack roll.

rules.name: Competitive
rules.description: Whenever a friendly Eugene Cooney model kills or makes Prone an enemy in melee, Harold adds 1Red to his melee attack rolls for the rest of the round.

rules.name: Quick
rules.description: Sandra may perform two Move Actions in the same round (if she has the Actions to spend). She may not run twice.

rules.name: Guilty Conscience
rules.description: Each time Smitty kills an enemy Survivor, roll 1Black. On a blank, he loses one Action in his next activation.

rules.name: Stab!
rules.description: When attacking with any weapon with the Sharp Keyword, if Thomas rolls two or more [!], he may immediately perform a second melee attack once the first is resolved. This extra attack cannot generate further attacks.

rules.name: Block & Tackle
rules.description: When Tyreese successfully performs a Shove! Action, he may spend 1SP to automatically Shove! all other enemy models in contact, whether Walker or Survivor (but not Herds).

rules.name: Paternal Rage
rules.description: If a friendly Julie model is killed, Tyreese gains the Multiple Attacks (2) and Fear Keywords for the rest of the game.
